---
title: Open Systematic Evidence Repository
---

Explore, access and reuse systematic review evidence.

This repository is a foundation for sharing approved aggregate data, analysis code and results from systematic reviews and meta-analyses.

[Browse research collections](reviews/index.qmd)

## Research transparency

Each published collection should link to its manuscript, data dictionary, analysis code and version-specific archival DOI when available. No actual research data have been deposited yet.
